The combination of severe anemia (Hb 8.3), thrombocytopenia (platelets 35,600), and a markedly elevated WBC with immature cells featuring Auer rods (pink, needle-shaped inclusions) is pathognomonic for this condition. This is a medical emergency requiring immediate attention.
